title: Task 607.1-1 — Return included activity configuration through the account API
body:
Owner: Sonja Seferasi (SS)
Parent SRS issue: #41 — SRS-607.1.
Traces to: UR-607.

## Task
Read activity name, description and included status from existing socialu.activities through the server-only Game Room bridge. Derive the account identity from the verified session and return the configuration from GET /api/game-room.

## Completion evidence
Implementation is in the submitted/merged code. See [merged PR #336](https://github.com/SonjaSeferasi/ssu-starter-app-v2/pull/336) and [reviewed main at 3727169](https://github.com/SonjaSeferasi/ssu-starter-app-v2/tree/3727169).

Code/test locations: app/api/game-room/route.ts; lib/game-room-server.ts; supabase/migrations/20261009000100_game_room_navigation.sql; __tests__/api/game-room.test.ts.

## Scope and dependencies
Reuse the existing table; do not invent reward amounts, points, activity counters or duplicate catalog data. Distinguish real account loading from the explicitly temporary missing-setup preview.
